title: nf-WGS-QC pipeline parameters
description: Whole genome sequencing quality control pipeline.

output_options.title: Output options
output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

project_id.description: A project ID string used in reports and manifests

reference_files.title: Reference files
reference_files.description: Input reference files shared by all workflows

genome_fasta.description: Path to reference genome FASTA file. A fasta index (.fai) must be present in the same location

regions_bed.description: Path to a BED file containing regions of interest. Additional stats over these regions will be computed for variants and coverage.

input_vcf.description: A samplesheet TSV file describing the variant files (vcf or g.vcf)

af_annotation_zip.description: An ECTHVAR compatible zip file used to annotate allele frequency for contamination estimates using CHARR

variant_stats_filter.description: Filter string to apply when selecting variants for variant stat computation

annotate_af.description: Perform AF annotation using echtvar when estimating variant contamination (needed for single samples or small cohorts)

charr_af_field.description: The name of the INFO field that contains the AF annotation (used during CHARR estimation)

input_bam.description: A samplesheet TSV file describing the alignment files (bam or cram)

somalier_vars.description: A VCF file containing variants set to be used with somalier

verifybamid_svd_file_prefix.description: Prefix for the SVD file set used by VerifyBamID2. Usually like 1000g.phase3.100k.b37.vcf.gz.dat

mosdepth_precision.description: Precision level when writing mosdepth coverage statistics

mosdepth_per_base_coverage.description: Compute mosdepth per base coverage. When active this slows down computation significantly

mosdepth_thresholds.description: Coverage targets for which to report regions fraction of bases

mosdepth_quantize_bins.description: Activate mosdepth quantized outputs and define the coverage bins

mosdepth_quantize_labels.description: Define custom labels for the quantized bins. When provided must match the numbers of configured bins

qrs_subset_reads.description: Number of reads to subset when computing quick reads stats

ped_file.description: A standard PED file describing relationship between samples. If omitted all samples are treated as unrelated

somalier_labels.description: Path to file describing sample labels for the somalier ancestry reference samples

somalier_1kgdata.description: Path to a folder containing somalier files for the ancestry reference samples

make_reports.description: Generate summary reports describing samples PASS/FAIL status

advanced_configuration_parameters.title: Advanced configuration parameters
advanced_configuration_parameters.description: Advanced parameters to control Nextflow pipeline execution

help.description: Show the help message for the pipeline.
help.help_text: If set to `true`, the pipeline will print a help message with the command to run it and the available parameters.

gpu_container_options.description: Special configuration parameters to pass to the container to use GPU resources

publish_dir_mode.description: Mode used when publishing files to output folder

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use colors in validation and other log messages
